text: The fix for this discrepancy lives in exactly one place: Finance's SUMIFS formula. Changing the upper bound from less-than-or-equal to just less-than makes the range half-open, excluding the quarter's first boundary day correctly.

Nothing else changes. The warehouse already used correct half-open logic, and Power BI and Tableau inherited that correctness — this is the same read-only-consumer principle from Lesson 2: fix the deliverable that actually had the bug, not the ones that never did.
The real bar for resolved is an exact match, not an approximate one. Re-running all three totals after the fix should show Power BI, Tableau, and Excel agreeing completely, with zero remaining gap.

A short documented note of what was wrong and what changed protects anyone who saw last week's incorrect total. Next lesson presents all three finished, correct deliverables to their actual audiences.
